validity.researcher_notes: Columbia Gas Transmission LLC and Columbia Gas of Ohio, Inc. are two entirely separate corporate entities that happen to share a legacy 'Columbia Gas' brand name. Columbia Gas Transmission LLC is the FERC-regulated INTERSTATE pipeline company NiSource sold to TransCanada in 2016 (TC Energy sold 40% of it to Global Infrastructure Partners in 2023) -- it plays no role in this intrastate Ohio distribution project. Columbia Gas of Ohio, Inc. is the LDC NiSource retained. NiSource's own FY2025 10-K Exhibit 21 lists 'Columbia Gas of Ohio, Inc.' as a current subsidiary and does not list 'Columbia Gas Transmission LLC' at all. See the Owner fill for full sourcing. This is likely a taxonomy confusion applied to other 'Columbia'-named rows in the batch; flagged as a cross-row lead below.
